title: Puppet Patience Theater
shareTitle: Puppet Patience Theater — Watch, Breathe, Take Turns
description: Join Fox in three cozy handmade puppet stories. Watch a friend go first, help Fox wait with slow flower breaths, then take a joyful turn on the swing, at the bakery, or in the parade.
learningGoals: Recognize that a friend going first does not mean losing a turn
Use slow breathing as a concrete strategy while waiting
Follow the predictable sequence Watch, Breathe, Your Turn
Experience patient turn-taking without timers, penalties, or failure
interactionModel: choose one of three felt-puppet stories, watch the first turn, tap a smiling flower for three to five paced breaths, then tap the story prop when Fox's turn arrives
feedbackModel: early prop taps receive a warm reminder; every breath earns a felt star; taking the turn triggers puppet celebration, three stars, and a curtain call

modes.title: Parade Turn
modes.skill: wait in line for a special role
